name: find-oss-alternative
description: Ask your agent to find an OSS alternative first, then build something better.

scripts.demo:rank: node scripts/rank-candidates.mjs --query "free open source typeless alternative AI dictation voice input any app hold hotkey polished text" --input examples/typeless-candidates.json
scripts.demo:html: mkdir -p outputs && node scripts/render-html-report.mjs --input examples/typeless-report.json --out outputs/typeless-report.html
scripts.check: node --check scripts/oss-directory-search.mjs && node scripts/github-repo-search.mjs "open source typeless alternative AI dictation" --limit 2 >/dev/null && node scripts/rank-candidates.mjs --query "typeless alternative" --input examples/typeless-candidates.json >/dev/null && node scripts/render-html-report.mjs --input examples/typeless-report.json --out /tmp/find-oss-alternative-report.html >/dev/null
